body.name: \(\mathcal O_{\kappa}\)
body.construction: For each \(\kappa\ge2\), take binary exogenous roots \(T_i,F_i\) for \(1\le i\le\kappa\) and the endogenous chain \(X\to S_1\to\cdots\to S_{\kappa}\to C_1\to\cdots\to C_{\kappa}=Y\), all actually zero, with the unintervened table of \(X\) constantly zero. With \(p\) denoting the chain predecessor, for every \(1\le i\le\kappa\) set \(S_i(p,T_i,F_i)=T_i\wedge F_i\) when \(p=0\) and \(S_i(p,T_i,F_i)=T_i\mathbin{\oplus}F_i\) when \(p=1\); add the shared edge \(T_i\to C_i\) and set \(C_i(p,T_i)=p\wedge T_i\). These displayed edges are the full graph, every displayed parent is functionally genuine, and these equations are the total local tables.
